approval: User approved use of the alternatives in this breakout provided voltage ratings allow.

substitutions.application: C1 is VBAT-to-GND; C2/C3 are BOOST_5V-to-GND. Intended battery/5V rails are below the unchanged 35V rating.
substitutions.qualification: JB-to-X5R change accepted for this breakout; effective capacitance versus bias/temperature and boost startup/ripple/stability remain bench-validation requirements.

substitutions.application: C4 is the 5V LM2663 flying capacitor; C5 bypasses -5V. Remaining parts AC-couple analog paths on the intended +/-5V design; conservative rail-to-rail envelope is 10V, below 50V.
substitutions.qualification: Keep manufacturer-application caveat visible: DigiKey lists Mobile Devices Only; the Murata reference sheet obtained through MCP is headed General Purpose. User accepts use for this breakout, not unrestricted production qualification. Validate effective capacitance, charge-pump performance and analog transfer; confirm packaging and height.

substitutions.application: 5pF compensation capacitor in the +/-5V op-amp/current-source path; 50V exceeds the intended rail-to-rail envelope.
substitutions.qualification: Retains 5pF, +/-0.1pF and C0G behavior while correcting the nominal package from legacy 0201 to actual PCB 0603. Validate compensation/stability on hardware.

release_limitations: Approved MPN choices for a low-voltage breakout do not constitute production or ordering approval.
Nominal rail connectivity is not a transient or fault-voltage proof; never apply external analog voltages beyond the circuit's limits.
No voltage rating is reduced, no capacitance value or footprint changed, and no tracks/pads/placement moved.
Recheck exact-MPN availability and packing before purchase; Mouser observed stock is below one full reel for both replacement groups.

R10 exact mechanical/pin fit remains unresolved. Feather host headers are intentionally DNP at manufacture; users fit compatible stacking headers later. Factory header selection is not a release blocker.
Capacitor DC-bias effective capacitance, rail regulation/ripple, I2C/DAC, analog performance and Howland stability must be bench-tested.
